- 1 -

ONE PIECE CARD GAME Comprehensive Rules
1. Game Overview
1-1. Number of Players
1-1-1. ONE PIECE CARD GAME is a game played by two players using decks built according to the deck construction rules.
1-3. Fundamental Principles
1-3-1. If the text of a card contradicts these Comprehensive Rules, the card text takes precedence.
Example: A card with [Rush] can attack on the turn it is played even though 6-5-2 normally prevents Characters from attacking on that turn.
1-3-2. When an effect instructs a player to perform multiple actions in order:
1. Perform the first action as much as possible.
2. Then perform the second action.

2

ONE PIECE CARD GAME Comprehensive Rules
7. Card Attacks and Battles
7-1. Attack Steps
7-1-1. Attack Step
7-1-1-1. The turn player declares an attack by resting an active Leader or Character and choosing a target.
7-1-2. Block Step
7-1-2-1. The non-turn player may activate [Blocker] on one of their active Characters to change the attack target.
7-1-4. Damage Step
7-1-4-1. If the attack is directed at an opposing Leader card and the attacking card's power is greater than or equal to the Leader's power:
7-1-4-1-1. Damage is dealt to the opposing Leader.
7-1-4-1-1-1. If the opponent has 0 Life at the point when it is determined that damage will be dealt, the attacking player wins the game.

15

10. Keyword Effects and Keywords
10-1. [Blocker]
10-1-1. [Blocker] is an effect that activates during the Block Step by resting the Character with [Blocker] and changing the target of the attack to that Character.
※ A Character with [Blocker] can only block while active.
